## Items

### <a id="prd-001"></a>PRD-001 · Core learning loop

**Program** · ◐ In Progress · P0 · owner MisanaProger · progress 31 % (unestimated)

A local-first trainer: the learner works on real Issues and problems in their own IDE, a mentor helps within an engagement level the learner consented to, and the platform assesses dependence on AI (ADI) and engineering skills (Skill Matrix) from observed events only. Stages 0–7 and 9 are shipped; stage 8 (interactive learning) and the desktop app are partly done.

**Documentation:** [`docs/architecture.md`](../../docs/architecture.md), [`README.md`](../../README.md)

**Source:** spec v0.3 §24, §30

#### <a id="prd-002"></a>PRD-002 · Projects and per-Issue workspaces

**Epic** · ✅ Done · P0 · release [REL-001](releases.md#rel-001) · owner MisanaProger

Local and remote repositories, detected languages and license, a workspace and branch per Issue, opening the external IDE, Git status and diff.

- **Parent:** [PRD-001](#prd-001) Core learning loop (In Progress)

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] A project is added from a local path or a remote URL and its languages and license are detected
- [x] Starting a task creates ~/.est/workspaces/<project>/<task> and the branch est/<task>
- [x] The session shows Git status and the diff against the base

**Components:** [`crates/est-projects`](../../crates/est-projects), [`crates/est-workspace`](../../crates/est-workspace), [`crates/est-git`](../../crates/est-git), [`frontend/src/project`](../../frontend/src/project), [`frontend/src/workspace`](../../frontend/src/workspace)

**Source:** spec v0.3 stage 1

#### <a id="prd-003"></a>PRD-003 · Tasks, Issues and online-judge problems

**Epic** · ✅ Done · P0 · release [REL-001](releases.md#rel-001) · owner MisanaProger

Tasks with statuses, sessions and acceptance criteria; Exercise Manifests; LeetCode and Codeforces problems with samples run in the sandbox; GitHub/GitLab Issues imported after a fixed-rule suitability check; discovery of Issues and problems planned by a model and run by code.

- **Parent:** [PRD-001](#prd-001) Core learning loop (In Progress)

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Exercise Manifests are imported and validated (est-exercises)
- [x] Problems are imported from pasted input or loaded from the judge with the learner's network permission
- [x] Issues are imported only after the suitability rules; re-import returns the same task
- [x] Discovery validates the model's search plan; candidates come only from search results

**Components:** [`crates/est-exercises`](../../crates/est-exercises), [`crates/est-problems`](../../crates/est-problems), [`crates/est-issues`](../../crates/est-issues), [`crates/est-remote`](../../crates/est-remote), [`crates/est-application/src/discovery.rs`](../../crates/est-application/src/discovery.rs), [`frontend/src/issue`](../../frontend/src/issue), [`frontend/src/problems`](../../frontend/src/problems), [`frontend/src/discovery`](../../frontend/src/discovery)

**Documentation:** [`docs/architecture.md`](../../docs/architecture.md)

**Source:** spec v0.3 stage 3

#### <a id="prd-004"></a>PRD-004 · Chat-first mentor with engagement levels

**Epic** · ✅ Done · P0 · release [REL-001](releases.md#rel-001) · owner MisanaProger

Conversations with cards and streaming answers; engagement levels L0–L4 decided in code, one-step escalation with explicit consent, the documentation boundary, code limits, several LLM providers switchable from the UI.

- **Parent:** [PRD-001](#prd-001) Core learning loop (In Progress)
- **Implements:** [LRN-002](learning.md#lrn-002) Engagement levels L0–L4 with consent (Done)

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Every new Issue starts at L0; escalation is one step and needs accept or the learner's own raise
- [x] The required level is decided by deterministic rules before any model call
- [x] Streaming shows prose only; code is withheld until the policy check of the whole answer

**Components:** [`crates/est-ai-policy`](../../crates/est-ai-policy), [`crates/est-ai`](../../crates/est-ai), [`crates/est-application/src/conversation.rs`](../../crates/est-application/src/conversation.rs), [`crates/est-application/src/streaming.rs`](../../crates/est-application/src/streaming.rs), [`frontend/src/chat`](../../frontend/src/chat), [`frontend/src/escalation`](../../frontend/src/escalation)

**Source:** spec v0.3 stages 4–5

#### <a id="prd-006"></a>PRD-006 · ADI and Skill Matrix

**Epic** · ✅ Done · P0 · release [REL-001](releases.md#rel-001) · owner MisanaProger

The learner sees their AI Dependency Index per Issue and over time, and a Skill Matrix assessed from evidence with status, confidence, dimensions and history.

- **Parent:** [PRD-001](#prd-001) Core learning loop (In Progress)
- **Implements:** [LRN-003](learning.md#lrn-003) ADI observed-0.2 (Done), [LRN-004](learning.md#lrn-004) Skill Matrix esm-catalog-0.2 (Done), [LRN-005](learning.md#lrn-005) Transfer by change of context (Done)

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] ADI and the Skill Matrix are computed independently and from observed events only
- [x] A skill without evidence is not_assessed, never zero
- [x] A model may explain an Issue's ADI but cannot change the number

**Components:** [`frontend/src/analytics/AdiPage.tsx`](../../frontend/src/analytics/AdiPage.tsx), [`frontend/src/analytics/SkillMatrixPage.tsx`](../../frontend/src/analytics/SkillMatrixPage.tsx), [`crates/est-application/src/analytics.rs`](../../crates/est-application/src/analytics.rs)

**Source:** spec v0.3 stage 7

#### <a id="prd-031"></a>PRD-031 · Transparent assessment

**Epic** · ◯ Planned · P0 · release [REL-002](releases.md#rel-002) · owner MisanaProger · progress 0 % (unestimated)

The learner can see why every assessment and recommendation is what it is: which actions, evidence, rule versions and models produced it.

##### <a id="prd-032"></a>PRD-032 · Why this assessment: evidence view

**Feature** · ◯ Planned · P0 · owner MisanaProger · risk medium

For every skill and discipline of the Skill Matrix, a list of the evidence behind it: type, Issue or lesson, date, help level, check result, reliability, rule version and a link to the source context.

- **Parent:** [PRD-031](#prd-031) Transparent assessment (Planned)
- **Implemented by:** [TEC-016](technical.md#tec-016) Assessment explanation API (Planned)

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Every score in the Skill Matrix links to the evidence records it was computed from
- [ ] Each record shows type, source, date, help level, check result, reliability and rule version
- [ ] Supported and independent work are visibly distinguished
- [ ] The computation (rule id and inputs) is shown and reproduces the displayed score
- [ ] All strings exist in en, ru and uz

**Documentation:** [`docs/specifications/evidence-assessment.md`](../../docs/specifications/evidence-assessment.md)

**Source:** TZ 2.1 (acceptance), 4.4

##### <a id="prd-046"></a>PRD-046 · Privacy controls

**Feature** · ◯ Planned · P0 · release [REL-001](releases.md#rel-001) · owner MisanaProger

View stored information, delete all learner data, manage learning history and switch the use of history for analytics on or off. Today only per-conversation deletion and a read-only privacy page exist.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Settings → Privacy lists what is stored, by category, with counts
- [ ] Delete all data removes every learner table and ~/.est secrets after an explicit confirmation
- [ ] Turning analytics off stops recommendations, discovery and the knowledge profile from reading history
- [ ] The switch is stored and reported by GET /settings/privacy
